corpus.self_play_status: in_progress_at_audit_time; gate already cleared on top-10 alone

falsification_gate.description: At least one pairwise cluster diff in median target production (>=1.0) OR median target distance (>=1.0). Tests whether geometry meaningfully drives the opening.

headline_findings: Boards cluster into 4 archetypes that produce visibly different openings.

The 'wide-and-rich' archetype (C2, n=13) gets >50% MORE launches in the first 30 turns than other clusters (10 vs 6-7) and targets the closest, highest-production planets — top-performer 'opening blitz' regime.
The 'close-quarters-orbital' archetype (C1, n=10) has the closest median target distance (29.6) and fewest distinct targets — opening focused, geometry-cramped.
Silhouette is modest (~0.17); clusters are statistically meaningful but soft. A meta-router classifier may need to predict cluster *probability* rather than hard label.
downstream_uses: Mine 3 opening atlas already cross-references cluster -> opening template.
Feeds Experiment Option 1 (map-type-conditional opening book) and Experiment Option 5 (meta-router refresh).
